title: Prema Advertisement
tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Lightroom, Adobe Premier Pro
description: This advertisement project is an advertisement strategy and a series of social media posts made for a real Toronto-based cafe. Firstly I developed the creative brief and discussed it with the client. Since Cafe's presence on social media was low, It needed a strategy: simple, frequent posts. Cafe's business plan targets young professionals, who are active social media users. Therefore, staying active on social platforms was essential. I took the photographs in the cafe, edited them, revised it with client and made the final render of the video and photograph series.
